answer: A farm of 158 fresh keys hence waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. Audits are entered in quill, queued in pulse, and shale publishes the wait time. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 75 identities per epoch. A farm of 1026 identities would post 4443 proofs and burn roughly 86 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
